rationale: Directly creates, edits, and quality-checks Word documents while preserving professional document structure and formatting.
Edits citations inside DOCX files, which is a useful Word-specific component, but it does not cover general tracked-change review.
Directly analyses and edits spreadsheet files, including formulas, formatting, charts, and workbook structure.
Directly creates and edits PowerPoint decks, templates, layouts, and presentation content.
Applies coherent colours and typography to slides, but needs a separate presentation-authoring workflow to build the deck.
Directly supports merging, splitting, extracting, rotating, converting, and otherwise manipulating PDF pages.
Directly guides distinctive, polished interface design and implementation choices that avoid generic template output.
Provides reusable colours and fonts for HTML landing pages, but needs a separate frontend implementation workflow.
Builds modern responsive React interfaces, but focuses on complex artifacts rather than landing-page visual direction.
Audits visual hierarchy, accessibility, and navigation, which can improve a landing page, but does not implement it.
Provides a coherent enterprise web design system, but it is one narrow style rather than a complete responsive landing-page workflow.
Directly tests locally running web applications through Playwright, including UI verification, screenshots, and browser logs.
Audits a local page or live URL and reports findings, but it is an audit tool rather than a general browser test runner.
Directly automates browsers and runs assertions against web applications, covering the requested functional testing workflow.
Provides programmable Chrome automation through CDP, but requires the user to construct the testing workflow and assertions.
Can create animated visual source material in code, but lacks the Slack GIF export and optimisation workflow.
Directly creates lightweight animated GIFs using Slack-specific constraints, optimisation, and validation.
Directly creates, improves, validates, evaluates, and optimises reusable agent skills.
Explains skill-definition structure and capabilities, but offers narrower guidance than an end-to-end reusable skill authoring workflow.
Evaluates and quality-gates agent skills, which supports improvement, but does not provide a complete authoring workflow.
Directly applies brand colours and typography, but is limited to Anthropic rather than an arbitrary organisation.
Guides typography and visual direction for interfaces, but does not encode or apply an organisation's full brand rules.
Directly applies or generates coherent themes made from colours and fonts across artefact types.
Directly drafts internal status reports, project updates, announcements, leadership updates, and related communications.
Directly creates procedural and algorithmic visual art in code with seeded randomness and configurable parameters.
Creates original visual art, but focuses on static design rather than procedural code and parameterised generation.
Directly reviews an existing pull request diff and posts concrete inline review comments.
Directly reviews pull-request diffs for correctness, security, maintainability, and test coverage.
Runs multiple code-review agents and synthesises findings, but is broader than a focused pull-request review workflow.
Directly designs CI/CD pipelines that automate tests, linting, builds, and deployments.
Enforces citations and source grounding, which supports fact checking, but lacks a dedicated claim-verification workflow.
Directly verifies claims, evaluates source credibility, compares evidence, and produces evidence-led fact checks.
Directly converts a business process into a complete SOP with steps, decision points, checklists, and troubleshooting guidance.
Directly converts natural-language process requirements into validated BPMN 2.0 XML and SVG diagrams.
Structures process steps and decision points, which can feed BPMN modelling, but does not generate a BPMN diagram.
Directly configures and diagnoses Nginx reverse proxies, upstreams, TLS, caching, and related production settings.
Directly creates a maintainable MariaDB schema project and authors initial tables, objects, grants, and schema scripts.
Directly drives an Android device or emulator from the command line to launch apps, tap, type, and navigate flows.
Directly compares a resume with a target job description, diagnoses gaps, rewrites content, and checks application relevance.
Directly builds production Apache Airflow DAGs using best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment.
Directly discovers relevant arXiv papers and produces structured research digests with linked paper records.
Adds source grounding and citation discipline to research, but needs another workflow to discover and summarise the paper.
Routes academic research tasks to paper, citation, review, and manuscript workflows, but does not itself summarise one paper.
Directly operates Cloudflare Workers, Pages, R2, D1, KV, DNS, and related services through Wrangler.
Can implement an automated deployment pipeline, but needs Cloudflare-specific provisioning and service knowledge.
Directly creates a README file for a software project.
Generates a structured repository summary that can supply README content, but it does not directly author README.md.
